steps.check: document.querySelectorAll('#c .sf-view-cards__card').length === 4 && [...document.querySelectorAll('#c .sf-view-cards__card')].filter((card) => card.tabIndex === 0).length === 1 && document.querySelector('#c .sf-view-cards__image').loading === 'lazy' && document.querySelector('#c [data-id=p4] .sf-view-cards__none') !== null && document.querySelector('#c [role=list]').getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Товары, 40'
